tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Technical Lead & Solution Specialist | Headless Commerce, PWA Integration & REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Technical lead and commerce backend specialist with 5+ years of enterprise experience architecting, extending, and supporting large-scale e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven track record designing RESTful APIs for headless commerce and Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontends. Strong background in solution design, PIM/ERP integrations, code reviews, and technical guidance for cross-functional teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce Technical Lead – Commerce Cloud (SFCC + PWA Kit)
cover_en.hook: Delivering robust enterprise commerce solutions requires a disciplined architectural mindset, strong API governance, and seamless headless storefront integration. Bringing over 5 years of enterprise commerce platform delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I offer proven technical leadership in headless architectures and PWA frontends.

bullets.label: Headless & PWA Architecture
bullets.text: Built and exposed robust RESTful APIs and headless web services at Shell and Rockwell Automation specifically tailored for Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontends and third-party integrations.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership & Quality
bullets.text: Conducted thorough code reviews, provided technical mentoring to junior developers, and engineered API migrations that strengthened system stability and data consistency across global channels.

bullets.label: Solution Design & Integration
bullets.text: Translated complex business requirements into scalable technical solution designs, resolving integration bottlenecks across ERP, PIM, and MDM ecosystems.

bullets.label: Performance & Scalability
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed under high enterprise loads, supported by structured agile DevOps practices.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit (no sponsorship required), I am currently serving my notice period with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical leadership and headless commerce background align with your platform initiatives.

tailoring.why_company: AGASTYA S. focuses on sophisticated commerce implementations where architectural precision and modern headless storefronts drive tangible business results. Leading technical delivery in enterprise commerce environments requires bridging scalable backend services with high-performing PWA touchpoints. My deep background in enterprise commerce architecture, REST APIs, and technical team guidance aligns directly with your mission to deliver resilient e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated to drive technical excellence and scalable headless commerce architectures, leveraging over 5 years of enterprise platform delivery and PWA API integration to lead high-performing engineering teams.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi Agastya, I noticed your search for an E-Commerce Technical Lead / Architect. With 5+ years architecting enterprise commerce backends, REST APIs, and PWA integrations at Shell and Rockwell, I'd love to connect and discuss how I can support your commerce platform goals.
tailoring.offer: From day one, I will provide hands-on technical guidance across API design and headless PWA integration while establishing robust code review standards. I will also streamline backend data flows and troubleshoot integration bottlenecks across third-party enterprise services.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Technical Lead – Commerce Cloud | Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am an enterprise e-commerce developer and technical lead with 5+ years of experience delivering scalable commerce backends and RESTful API integrations for Rockwell Automation and Shell.

Your focus on modern headless commerce and PWA architectures requires deep expertise in API design, performance optimization, and cross-functional technical leadership. I bring proven experience architecting headless services for PWA frontends, guiding engineering teams, and optimizing complex enterprise integrations.

My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I look forward to discussing how my experience can support your technical roadmap.

Kind regards,
Kranti Chavan
